thread:
maria (Finance): Hey team — got a credit memo from CloudVendor APAC for -$12,345 but it has NO PO on it. Approvals system rejected auto-apply. Vendor wants it netted against INV-489321. Can someone confirm how we should route?
approvals-bot: Invoice/credit memo 2026-03-23-1842507890 added to approvals queue. Auto-match failed: PO missing.
cloudvendor-apac: Hi Maria, sorry about that — our AP system dropped the PO number on the credit. Reference on our side: INV-489321-CM, original invoice 489321. We can reissue with PO if needed.
jonas (Procurement): @maria can you attach the credit memo PDF? Need to see contract/terms before routing. :eyes:
maria (Finance): attaching snippet of the memo here:
```
CLOUDVENDOR APAC
Credit Memo #: CM-2026-334
Amount: -12,345.00 USD
Reference: INV-489321-CM
PO: -- (blank)
Notes: credit for overbilling 2026-02 usage
```
nate (EngOps): If this is just a usage correction and contract allows credits, we can apply it. But Proc needs to confirm there's no PO requirement for credits.
jonas (Procurement): Contract (SOW v3) section 4.2 says credits must reference original PO or get written procurement exception. No PO = needs exception form + director sign-off.
maria (Finance): OK. Vendor offered to reissue with PO but says it will delay cash application by a week. Vendor asking for immediate netting against INV-489321 to speed reconciliation.
elaine (Finance Dir): @jonas @maria If vendor can give written confirmation tying CM to INV-489321 and contract shows credits allowed (which it does), I'll sign the procurement exception. Provide GL code and I'll approve. :thumbsup:
maria (Finance): GL: 6102-Cloud-SaaS. Vendor confirmation (copied) — they wrote: "CloudVendor APAC confirms CM-2026-334 applies to INV-489321 and is agreed by both parties."
elaine (Finance Dir): Approved. Please route through approvals system as "procurement exception - credit memo without PO" and tag me. Once applied, reconcile INV-489321 to show credit applied.
approvals-bot: Exception created: EXC-7721, routed to Elaine (Finance Dir) for sign-off. Status: signed.
maria (Finance): Thanks everyone — I'll apply the credit manually against INV-489321 and update the ledger. Vendor, please resend the reissued CM with PO when you can and we'll close the exception.
cloudvendor-apac: Thanks Maria — will reissue PO'd CM and send over. Appreciate fast handling. :pray:
